verdict.rationale: Gemini's 'Connected Apps' lets it take permissioned actions inside specific integrated apps (Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Flights, third-party productivity apps) and Android's 'what's on my screen' feature gives some screen context, but this is limited to a curated set of app integrations rather than general computer-use (seeing arbitrary screens and operating any application via clicks/keystrokes). Missing for 10: evidence of general screen perception/control across arbitrary desktop apps, autonomous multi-step UI operation, and independent hands-on verification of this action-taking capability.
